name: Asteria
description_short: On-chain strategy game where everything is a UTxO.
description_long: Fully on-chain bot challenge built for developers to showcase the eUTxO model. Code a bot that pilots a ship across a 2D grid where every entity — ships, fuel pellets, rewards — is a Cardano UTxO governed by Aiken validators. Reach the center to claim the reward pool. Open source (Apache-2.0), anyone can run their own challenge.
